author: TommyWolf11BR
quote:
Talk about a major regret—the game had the potential to be a masterpiece, but instead, they turned it into a "cuckold/simp simulator" and a story about an "empowered" female character with Borderline Personality Disorder. Screw you, @rockstargames—I really wish I could get my money back.

Pensa num arrependimento, jogo tinha potencial pra ser um master piece, mas fizeram um cuck hold/ gado simulator, e as aventuras de uma Fêmea com Borderline empoderada, TNC @rockstargames como eu queria meu dinheiro de volta.
